instruction: A balance was 5000 cents on Monday and 5400 cents on Friday. There was exactly one deposit on Wednesday and daily interest on Tuesday through Friday. The interest rate and deposit amount are not recorded. What was the Wednesday deposit in cents? Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory. For this instance, let q denote the integer quantity requested above. Report q + 5735 instead of q.
